title: cozy home upgrades (all under $40)
caption: turn the big light off and the whole place changes. save this for later #apartmentdecor #cozyhome #homedecor #renterfriendly

slides.title: lamps, not the overhead light
slides.detail: 2–3 small lamps with warm 2700k bulbs. lamps run $20–40, bulbs about $3.

slides.title: a pothos on the shelf
slides.detail: nearly impossible to kill and it trails as it grows. small pots run $10–20.

slides.title: warm string lights
slides.detail: plug-in fairy lights along a shelf, mirror or headboard. about $10–15.

slides.title: curtains hung high and wide
slides.detail: mount the rod near the ceiling so the room feels taller. $20–40 a pair.

slides.title: new pillow covers
slides.detail: swap the covers, keep the inserts. rust, cream or olive run $10–20 each.
